summary: Hospital visit abroad after a fall, fractured wrist
story: On June 27 I slipped on wet cobblestones walking down a hill in the Alfama district of Lisbon and landed on my right hand. My wrist swelled up immediately, so I took a taxi to a private hospital. They took X-rays, found a fracture, set it under sedation and put on a cast. I paid the hospital bill myself by card. The itemized bill and the medical report are attached.

items.description: Emergency room visit, X-rays, fracture reduction under sedation and cast

documents.name: Hospital itemized bill
documents.content: Hospital Santa Clara, Lisbon. Patient: Aiko Tanaka. June 27, 2026. Emergency consultation: $450.00. X-rays, right wrist, two series: $380.00. Closed reduction under sedation: $2,350.00. Cast and sling: $420.00. Medication: $200.00. Total paid by card: $3,800.00.

documents.name: Medical report
documents.content: Hospital Santa Clara, emergency department, June 27, 2026. Patient Aiko Tanaka, age 34, presented after a fall on a wet street one hour earlier. No relevant medical history. No regular medication. Diagnosis: displaced distal radius fracture, right wrist. Treatment: closed reduction under sedation, below-elbow cast. Fit to fly with the cast split. Follow up with an orthopedic physician at home within 10 days.

decision.reason: The receipts support the claim under the plan's limits.
